acceptanceCriteria: A command emits a per-hunk draft plan whose spans resolve at BASE and are not all identical
The draft is labelled proposed and is never accepted without the lane writing it to the plan file
On a replay of PR #1457's diff, the draft passes the DCW-V0-048 uniformity check
dogfood-finish names the helper in its empty/uniform refusal
body: On 2026-10-21, four lanes (PRs #1453, #1455, #1457 and journal #1454's earlier try) lost a dogfood try to empty-citation-plan or citation-plan-uniform (DCW-V0-048). #1457 ended NOT_PRODUCED after two tries. Expected: a helper (for example `corvint dogfood cite --propose`) emits a draft per-hunk citation plan from BASE: the enclosing spec section for spec hunks, the caller or the test for code hunks, and the build-log decision for docs. The lane then edits the draft instead of writing it from scratch. Actual: each lane writes the plan by hand and often cites one span for every hunk.

title: dogfood: lanes waste their first bind try on a uniform or empty citation plan; propose per-hunk BASE spans
